antagū.p: [Anta+gamu+rū] (pu) CL=9 See Niti, Sutta. 1118.] (1) reached the ebd; one. See Vedantagū. (a) reached the end of suffering by the three kinds of Pariññā; one. (Buddha, Arahant). (b) reached the end-climax of all evil deeds; one. (The Mara). (2) causes the death. He (the Māra).
